name: R109-dusclops-curse-last-pokemon
why: Challenge 6. The player's Dusclops (666: Double-Edge, Shadow Ball, Curse, Rest) leads. Its Curse puts a quarter-HP end-of-turn damage on the foe; when the cursed foe is the opponent's last Pokemon and is at or below a quarter HP, the Curse damage faints it at the end of the turn and the battle ends there (BattleScript_CurseTurnDmg, runDoBattlerEndTurnEffects). The player plays random legal actions (Curse is one of four moves).
